description: Open-ended period: Period.start only. The unknown endpoint must stay unknown - no Period.end triple is emitted and none is invented.
reviewer_note: Concept note section 6 lists 'in-progress' and 'open-ended period' as two variants without saying whether a finished Encounter may have no end. This fixture pairs the open period with in-progress rather than inventing a finished-with-no-end resource. See DR-102 question Q-A2-3.
